name: rentemester-workspace-bootstrap-saga-v4
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rm_workspace_bootstrap_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  reservation_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(reservation_hash) = 64),
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('reserved', 'identity_created', 'mail_confirmed', 'access_completed')),
  user_id TEXT REFERENCES "user"(id),
  company_slug TEXT,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) > 0),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CHECK(
    (event_type = 'reserved' AND user_id IS NULL AND company_slug IS NOT NULL)
    OR (event_type IN ('identity_created', 'mail_confirmed') AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND company_slug IS NULL)
    OR (event_type = 'access_completed' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND company_slug IS NOT NULL)
  )
);

-- One workspace has exactly one initial identity reservation. The opaque HMAC
-- is intentionally the only email-derived value kept in the saga/audit state.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rm_workspace_bootstrap_singleton_reserved
  ON rm_workspace_bootstrap_events(event_type)
  WHERE event_type = 'reserved';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rm_workspace_bootstrap_reservation_idx
  ON rm_workspace_bootstrap_events(reservation_hash, id);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS rm_workspace_bootstrap_events_no_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_workspace_bootstrap_events
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workspace bootstrap events are append-only');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS rm_workspace_bootstrap_events_no_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON rm_workspace_bootstrap_events
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workspace bootstrap events are append-only');
END;
